description: Ground-truth expectations for racemap. Covers the reported algif_skcipher race, four zero-copy attack-surface patterns (A-D), and two known CVEs. Each pattern/CVE fixture holds a vulnerable and a fixed variant via #ifdef FIXED; the scanner must flag the vulnerable variant as likely_race and exonerate the fixed variant.

impact: unsnapshotted shared state passed to async request

cases.rationale: io_uring registered buffer fed to crypto without copy/unpin.
pipe page consumed without pipe_buf_get/.get callback.
get_user_pages result fed to AEAD without COW/put_page.
skb mutated after skb_zerocopy without skb_unshare.
PIPE_BUF_FLAG_CAN_MERGE without flag init / page-ownership check (Dirty Pipe).
copy_from_user under mmap_read_lock with no VMA stability re-check.
